menunow.short-description: MenuNow is my online menu service for restaurants: owners create and edit their menu by writing on WhatsApp, and guests open it from the QR code on the table.

list.1: Design and development of the service, which I run as a sole proprietorship
list.2: AI agent that edits dishes, prices, sections and design from WhatsApp messages
list.3: WhatsApp Cloud API integration: text, voice notes, photos and PDFs
list.4: Menu websites on dedicated subdomains, with allergens and images
list.5: Table QR codes and printable PDFs generated in chat
list.6: Node.js + Express backend with PostgreSQL and Drizzle
